create_flux_pipeline_config: create a FluxPipelineConfig for text-to-image generation with CLIP and T5 text encoders
build_flux2_pipeline_config: build a Flux2PipelineConfig for image-to-image generation with Flux2Mistral text encoder
create_flux2_klein_config: create a Flux2KleinPipelineConfig for distilled generation with Qwen3 text encoder and no guidance
run_flux2_postprocess_text: run flux2_postprocess_text to stack hidden states from layers 10, 20, 30 and reshape into prompt embeddings
run_flux2_pack_latents: run flux2_pack_latents to reshape latents from (B, C, H, W) to (B, H*W, C) for transformer processing
